recipes.projection: TwoGun mode: Proj is TwoGun's own DraftKings projection for the 322 players he projects (board updated Sun, Nov 8, 11:35 AM ET), used exactly as he publishes it; his game lines replace ESPN's where he has one. The other 248 players keep the current projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage leaves the projection blank, flagged "no projection", unless the injury report lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection is 0.
recipes.ownership: TwoGun only: Own% is TwoGun's projected ownership for a Milly Maker-size field for the 321 players he lists one for (ownership updated Sun, Nov 8, 9:27 AM ET); the source choices leave missing players blank, so every other player's Own% is blank: the app never estimates ownership.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)
